column1: What is the federal character principle?
column2: The constitutional rule meant to spread federal appointments and posts fairly across the country.

column1: Who has accused the government of lopsided appointments?
column2: Atiku, the Northern Elders Forum and Ohanaeze; Senator Ali Ndume said the ambassador list shortchanged the North-East.

column1: What did the Presidency's appointment list show by geopolitical zone?
column2: North-West 35, South-West 29, North-Central 25, North-East 24, South-South 22, South-East 16.

column1: What North–South split of appointments did a Presidency summary give?
column2: 71 from the North and 63 from the South.

column1: Why must callers not quote the appointment numbers as final?
column2: The Presidency apologised for errors in the list and withdrew it the same day.

column1: Give an example of why federal character is more than counting ethnic groups.
column2: NNPC chief Bayo Ojulari is ethnically Yoruba but from northern Kwara State (Simon Kolawole's example).

column1: What is the difference between the slot-count answer and the critics' "real power" argument?
column2: Slot counts show the North has more appointees (71 vs 63); critics reply that real power lies in which key agencies are held, not the count.

column1: How much has been committed to South-East roads and bridges?
column2: Over ₦1.3 trillion, according to Works Minister Umahi; Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele repeated the figure in May 2026.

column1: Give examples of funded South-East road projects.
column2: Second Niger Bridge access roads (Section 2A Delta ₦146bn, 2B Anambra ₦176bn); 208km Enugu-Onitsha road (₦202bn MTN tax credit plus ₦150bn); 61km of the Enugu-bound Enugu-Port Harcourt lane complete, per Umahi.

column1: Why should callers not credit the Second Niger Bridge to this administration?
column2: Umahi says the bridge was finished before Tinubu took office; the current work is on its access roads.

column1: What is the caveat on the South-East Development Commission (SEDC)?
column2: It reportedly got hardly any money in 2025 and less than 10% of its ₦140bn 2026 budget had been released, so do not say it is fully funded.

column1: When were the regional development commission laws signed?
column2: In 2024, by President Tinubu, including the law creating the SEDC.

column1: Give examples of northern projects cited against "the North is sidelined".
column2: Abuja-Kaduna-Kano road (350km, ₦764bn; Kano section ~95% complete), Sokoto-Gusau-Funtua-Zaria (275km, ₦824bn), Sokoto-Badagry highway, 614km AKK gas pipeline and Kaduna-Kano rail.

column1: How do Sokoto-Badagry and Lagos-Calabar support the balance argument?
column2: Together they give both the north and south ends of the country a major highway project.

column1: What first does Umahi claim for the South-East?
column2: That the South-East has a Minister of Works for the first time.

column1: How should callers treat project figures quoted by the Works Minister?
column2: Attribute them to Umahi, check progress before quoting, and never present them as proof of completion.
